R-finish-search-isolated-001: Synthetic executions establish adapter behavior only; actual Mac anchor acceptance remains required.
R-finish-search-isolated-001: Sampled candidates and reused development data are not a pristine final test.
R-finish-search-isolated-001: Full feature dictionary is computed upstream; selected column count does not measure feature computation savings.
R-finish-search-isolated-001: Upstream metrics use integer item fallback; port uses lexical IDs if a 64-bit tie-key collision occurs.
